title: The i and u signs, ব and ঈ
body:
# Lesson 3: The i and u signs, ব and ঈ

Two i signs, short ি and long ী, and the u sign ু. In Kolkata speech short and long i sound the same; the difference is only spelling. Plus ব (b) and ঈ, the rare long-i vowel letter.

| Script | Sound | Note |
|---|---|---|
| ◌ি | i-kar: i | Written first, read second: মি is m then i. |
| ◌ী | dirgho i-kar: i | Mirror of ি; hangs on the right. Sounds the same as ি. |
| ◌ু | u-kar: u | A small hook under the letter. |
| ব | bo (b) | Triangle shape. No dot below; র is the same shape WITH a dot. |
| ঈ | i (long vowel letter) | Mostly seen in ঈদ (Eid); sounds just like i. |

## How they combine

ি is written BEFORE the consonant but said after it: ম + ি = মি **mi**. ী and ু come after or under: নী **ni**, তু **tu**.

## Read these

Cover the right side, read the script aloud, then check.

- আমি → ami: I
- তুমি → tumi: you (friend)
- কুকুর → kukur: dog
- কিনলাম → kinlam: I bought
- বাবা → baba: dad
- নীল → nil: blue

cards.Meaning: vowel sign short i, written BEFORE the consonant
cards.Notes: Written first, read second: মি is m then i.

cards.Meaning: vowel sign long i, written after the consonant
cards.Notes: Mirror of ি; hangs on the right. Sounds the same as ি.

cards.Meaning: vowel sign short u, hooked under the consonant
cards.Notes: A small hook under the letter.
Triangle shape. No dot below; র is the same shape WITH a dot.

cards.Meaning: independent vowel long i, rare at the start of a word
cards.Notes: Mostly seen in ঈদ (Eid); sounds just like i.

cards.Example: আমি কিনলাম ami kinlam: I bought (it)
cards.Notes: আ a + ম m + ি i: the ি is written before ম.

cards.Example: তুমি আর আমি tumi aar ami: you and me
cards.Notes: ত t + ু u + ম m + ি i.

cards.Example: আমার কুকুর amar kukur: my dog
cards.Notes: ক k + ু u + ক k + ু u + র r: final o silent.

cards.Example: আমি কলম কিনলাম ami kolom kinlam: I bought a pen
cards.Notes: ক k + ি i + ন n + ল l + া aa + ম m: n has no vowel sound here.

cards.Example: আমার বাবা amar baba: my dad
cards.Notes: ব b + া aa + ব b + া aa.

cards.Example: নীল কলম nil kolom: a blue pen
cards.Notes: ন n + ী i + ল l: long i, same sound as short.
